title: Provide package cache to aldoc when building reference documentation
summary: The aldoc command now receives a populated package cache to resolve cross-module references in generated reference documentation, fixing unresolved links that occurred when building documentation for artifact-based apps.
key_points: aldoc now receives --packagecache parameter with all apps and their dependencies
Fixes 'Referenced module not loaded' errors in reference documentation
Resolves cross-module links in generated documentation
Uses dependencies already computed by CalculateProjectsAndApps
Addresses issue with artifact-based apps lacking default package cache
